title: Fuselage — Forward Cargo Door Surround — Titanium Corner Fittings and Increased Cut-Out Radius

ata.title: Fuselage Section 13 — Forward — Door Surround Structure

abstract: In-service installation of titanium corner fittings and an increased cut-out radius at the forward cargo door of the CIRRANE-11, closing the static margin shortfall found in the revised freight loading re-analysis.

sections.planning_reason: Re-analysis of the CIRRANE-11 forward cargo door cut-out against the revised high-density freight loading case returned a static reserve factor of 1.02 at the lower corner fittings, below the 1.15 target the programme applies to door surrounds. The shorter fuselage puts the door closer to the wing carry-through and the corner sees a higher shear flow than the equivalent CIRRANE-13 station. An interim 8 000 flight cycle detailed visual inspection was introduced pending this bulletin, and it is withdrawn on embodiment.
sections.description: The four aluminium corner fittings at the forward cargo door cut-out are replaced by machined titanium items and the cut-out corner radius is increased from 40 mm to 55 mm by routing to a template. The intercostal is re-drilled to the new fastener pattern and the door surround stringer gains a local doubler at the lower run-out.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Put the cargo door in the maintenance position and remove the sill panel in zone 891. Remove the cargo lining panels in zones 111 and 113 to expose the door surround structure. Remove the four corner gussets D5321130372071. Rout the corner radius to 55 mm using the routing template from the tooling set and blend the edge to the finish given in the accomplishment instructions. Do a dye penetrant inspection of every routed edge and an eddy current inspection of the adjacent fastener rows. Re-drill the intercostal D5321133887188 to the new pattern using the drill jig. Install the local doubler on the stringer D5321132983318. Install the four titanium fittings wet with sealant using bolts AES495354-07 and torque in the sequence given. Restore the protective treatment and the external finish. Install the lining and sill panels, do the cargo door operational test, and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to CIRRANE-11 aircraft MSN C00028 through C00455 that are pre modification standard. Aircraft delivered from MSN C00466 onward were built with the titanium fittings. The CIRRANE-13 forward cargo door is a different station and a different cut-out and is expressly not covered by this bulletin.
sections.material_note: Kit K5321-1021-01 contains the four titanium fittings, the stringer doubler, the fastener set and the routing template hire. Lead time is thirty-four weeks. Removed aluminium fittings are returned to Aeralis for credit.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled C-check, or within 48 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
